payload.entry: Journal phase API record: Rust sase_core::axe_chop::batch (CHOP_BATCH_SCHEMA_VERSION=1) owns validate_chop_batch_manifest, apply_chop_batch_transition (begin_dispatch/acknowledge_launch/record_skip/mark_blocked/request_pause/resume/cancel_clan_generation), reconcile_chop_batch, summarize_chop_batch; PyO3 bindings chop_batch_wire_schema_version/validate_chop_batch_manifest/apply_chop_batch_transition/reconcile_chop_batch/summarize_chop_batch; sase facade in src/sase/core/axe_chop_facade.py (CHOP_BATCH_SCHEMA_VERSION + 4 functions); store src/sase/axe/chop_batch_store.py (pending_batches/ dir beside runs/, atomic temp+fsync+replace+dir-fsync writes, in-process mutex + flock mutation lock, separate ownership lock). Lock order for later phases: admission lock -> agent-name lock -> batch mutation lock -> batch ownership lock. Symvision whitelist rows keyed to sase-1tc.3.1 in Justfile _lint-symvision.

Focused regressions: 89 passed.
